blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Tracking a novel object's 6D pose over long horizons currently requires either expensive onboarding or a reconstruction maintained throughout the sequence. This makes current trackers impractical for robotic manipulation and augmented reality, which need trackers that are ready to use and run in real time. We show that a lightweight tracking module can be applied on top of a wide range of correspondence estimation methods to keep drifts bounded while maintaining fast runtime. Our key idea is to avoid point-based optimization in the pose graph and operate only on relative pose constraints, which we weight by a derived uncertainty from the geometric alignment. This makes optimization independent of the number of correspondences while avoiding the direct inclusion of noisy point measurements, leading to fast and robust long-term tracking. Across four real-world benchmarks, our approach achieves tracking accuracy comparable to reconstruction-based trackers with a fraction of the optimization cost. Overall, these results suggest that a compact and reliable pose graph optimization can provide long-horizon consistency at substantially lower computational cost.
blocks.zh: 追踪一个小物体的6D在长视野上的姿势,目前需要的是昂贵的登船或者在整个序列中保持重建. 这使得目前的追踪器对机器人操纵和增强现实不切实际,这需要随时可以使用和运行的追踪器. 我们显示,轻量级跟踪模块可以应用在广泛的函证估计方法之上,在保持快速运行时间的同时保持漂移的界限. 我们的关键想法是避免在姿势图中基于点的优化,而只在相对的姿势限制上运行,我们用几何对齐所产生的不确定性来权衡这些限制. 这使得优化与函数独立,同时避免直接包含噪点测量,从而导致快速而有力的长期跟踪. 在四种现实世界基准中,我们的方法实现了追踪准确性,与基于重建的追踪器相当,其优化成本只有一小部分。 总的来说,这些结果表明,一个紧凑和可靠的图型优化可以提供长距离的一致性,同时大大降低计算成本。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Tracking an object’s 6D pose over time is important for understanding dynamic environments, with applications in robotic manipulation [ 31 , 44 ] , augmented reality [ 1 ] , and human–object
interaction [ 14 ] .
Two requirements make this problem challenging in practice: the tracking must run online at interactive rates to support downstream planning, and it must remain accurate and temporally consistent over long horizons despite occlusions and fast motions.
blocks.zh:
跟踪物体的6D外形对了解动态环境很重要,在机器人操纵中应用[31,44],增强现实[1],以及人类对象
互动 [14].
有两项要求使这一问题在实践中具有挑战性:跟踪必须在网上以互动的速度进行,以支持下游规划,而且尽管存在排斥和快速行动,跟踪必须保持准确和时间上的一致性。

blocks.en:
Existing approaches satisfy these two requirements one at a time.
Long-horizon accuracy is typically obtained by anchoring poses to a 3D representation, either built online during tracking [ 42 , 18 , 9 ] or onboarded beforehand from CAD models or posed reference frames [ 43 ] .
While both approaches can be accurate, the first is too slow for real-time use and the second must be repeated for every new object.
Interactive rates without onboarding can be achieved by relative pose estimation methods [ 23 , 24 , 20 ] , which estimate pose from a single reference observation.
However, these operate only on pairs of frames, so small errors in relative motion compound over time and cause drift.
blocks.zh:
现有办法一次满足这两项要求。
长视距精确度通常是通过将平面投放到3D代表台上而获得的,这种投放台要么是在跟踪过程中在线建造的[42、18、9],要么是事先从CAD模型中安装的,要么是提出参考框架[43]。
虽然这两种方法都可以准确,但第一种方法太慢,不能实时使用,第二种方法必须重复用于每个新对象.
非入职的互动率可以通过相对的平面估计方法[23,24,20]实现,这种估计来自单一的参考观察.
然而,它们只在一对相框上操作,因此随着时间推移,相对运动复合物发生小错误并引起漂移.

blocks.en:
We show that both requirements can be met by constraining pairwise measurements against each other in a pose graph without maintaining a 3D representation.
While pose graph optimization (PGO) is widely used in vision and robotics, existing object trackers typically build their graph constraints directly from correspondences or dense geometric observations.
We instead ask: once relative motion has been estimated from a set of correspondences, is it necessary to retain those points in the global optimization?
blocks.zh:
我们显示,这两种要求都可以通过在不保持三维表示的情况下在平面图中相互限制对等测量而达到。
虽然平面图优化(PGO)被广泛用于视觉和机器人,但现有的对象跟踪器通常会直接从函证或密集几何观测中构建出其图形约束.
相反,我们问:一旦从一套通信中估计出相对运动,是否有必要在全球优化中保留这些点?

blocks.en:
Our key idea is to compress each set of correspondences into a relative pose measurement and perform global optimization only over poses.
This has two advantages.
When correspondences are reliable, many inliers may be available and the relative pose is already well constrained. Retaining all of those points in the global objective only increases the optimization cost, whereas our update cost is independent of the number of inliers.
When correspondences are poor, directly placing noisy points in the global objective also exposes the optimization to their errors.
By operating only on relative pose constraints, we avoid both costs.
blocks.zh:
我们的关键想法是将每组通信压缩成相对的姿势测量,并进行全球优化。
这有两个好处。
当信件可靠时,可能有许多发件机,相对的姿势已经受到很大限制。 在全球目标中保留所有这些点只会增加优化成本,而我们的更新成本则独立于升降机的数量。
当函文差的时候,将吵分直接放入全球目标中,也会使优化暴露出其出错.
仅仅依靠相对的限制行动,就可避免这两种代价。

blocks.en:
This formulation shifts the main question from how many correspondences are retained to how much each relative pose measurement should be trusted.
We therefore derive a pose uncertainty from the geometric alignment that produced each relative transform and use it to weight the corresponding graph constraint.
Poorly constrained measurements contribute less, while reliable measurements are enforced more strongly.
The result is a lightweight tracking module that can be paired with a wide range of correspondence estimation methods ( Fig. 1 ) and, in our experiments, achieves accuracy comparable to reconstruction- and CAD-based methods at substantially lower runtime.
blocks.zh:
这一表述方式将主要问题从保留多少函证转移到每个相对的计量应信任多少。
因此,我们从产生每个相对变换的几何比对中得出一个不确定因素,并利用它来权衡相应的图表限制。
受到制约的计量办法较少,而可靠的计量办法则更加有力。
结果是一个轻量级跟踪模块,可以与广泛的函证估计方法(图1)相配;在我们实验中,在运行时间大大降低的情况下,实现与基于重建和CAD的方法相可比较的精度.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Pose Estimation
blocks.zh: 2.1 Pose估计

blocks.en:
Estimating camera poses is central for scene- and object-level understanding.
A common approach is to estimate correspondences through feature matching and then solve camera poses through classical geometry, such as the eight-point algorithm [ 16 ] or Perspective-n-Point (PnP) [ 21 ] .
Scene-level pipelines [ 10 , 35 ] typically focus on relative transformations between RGB images and rely on (dense) 2D–2D correspondences.
To improve robustness across diverse scenes and large viewpoint changes, recent approaches adopt deep learning-based matchers [ 36 , 12 , 11 , 22 , 34 ] trained on large-scale data, which substantially outperform hand-crafted features [ 27 , 33 ] .
blocks.zh:
估计相机的姿势是场景和物体级理解的核心.
一个常见的方法是通过特征匹配来估计对应,然后通过古典几何来解析相机所呈现的相机,如八分算法 [16] 或 Perspect-n-Point (PnP) [21].
场景级管线[10,35]一般侧重于RGB图像之间的相对转换并依赖(ense)2D–2D通信.
为提高不同场景的稳健性和大视角变化,最近的方法采用了基于深层学习的配对者[36、12、11、22、34],这些配对者接受了大规模数据培训,大大超过了手工制作的特征[27、33]。

blocks.en:
In object-centric settings, pose estimation methods [ 43 , 25 , 4 , 13 , 37 ] often learn 3D object representations to model geometry and appearance.
Relative pose estimation methods for novel objects [ 24 , 23 , 20 ] instead predict the relative transformation between two frames without requiring instance-specific object knowledge (e.g. CAD models, multiple reference frames).
These methods can generalize to unseen objects and can handle moderate viewpoint changes.
In this work, we propose a general tracking module which can be paired with both 2D feature matchers and relative object pose estimation methods and improves temporal consistency by fusing pairwise measurements over time.

blocks.en: 2.2 Pose Graph Optimization
blocks.zh: 2.2 Pose图优化

blocks.en:
Pose graph optimization (PGO) [ 2 , 3 ] estimates absolute poses from pairwise constraints by enforcing consistency over a graph.
It has been widely used across structure-from-motion [ 30 , 46 ] , SLAM [ 28 ] , and robotics [ 8 ] .
Importantly, different systems instantiate PGO with different residual models, where some optimize alignment-based residuals defined directly on correspondences [ 6 ] , while others represent pairwise relations as relative-pose factors and optimize pose-consistency residuals in S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) poses [ 7 , 46 , 30 ] .
While both types are common in scene-level pipelines, pose-consistency terms have received comparatively little attention in object-centric RGB-D tracking, where prior work more commonly relies on alignment-based objectives. Dellaert et al. introduced factor-graph formulations and the Bayes tree data structure for incremental smoothing and mapping (iSAM2) [ 19 ] , which supports low-latency updates without periodic batch steps through fluid relinearization and incremental variable reordering.
In this work, we integrate iSAM2 to efficiently update our 6D object pose graph online as new frames arrive.
blocks.zh:
Pose图优化(PGO) [2, 3] 通过在图上执行一致性,从对等约束中估算出绝对值.
它在结构自动[30,46],SAM[28],机器人[8]之间被广泛使用.
重要的是,不同的系统即时处理PGO具有不同的剩余模型,其中一些优化了直接从函证上定义的基于对齐的后遗症[6],而另一些则代表了相对可能因素的对偶关系并优化了SE(3)SE(3)中的姿势一致性后遗症[7,46,30].
虽然这两种类型在场景级管线中都很常见,但在以对象为核心的RGB-D跟踪中,姿势一致性术语得到的注意相对较少,而之前的工作更常依赖于基于对齐的目标. Dellaert等引入了因子图配体和贝叶斯树数据结构来进行递增平滑和绘图(iSAM2)[19],通过流体再线化和递增可变重排支持低纬度更新而无需定期分批步骤.
在这项工作中,我们整合了iSAM2,以便随着新帧的到来,高效地更新我们的6D对象在线平面图.

blocks.en: 2.3 Object 6D Pose Tracking
blocks.zh: 2.3 物体6D Pose跟踪

blocks.en:
BundleTrack [ 40 ] is an early framework for novel-object 6D pose tracking that does not require CAD models.
It combines feature matching with a memory-augmented pose graph that is optimized through an alignment loss on unprojected point clouds (similar to [ 6 ] ).
BundleSDF [ 42 ] extends this line of work by integrating an online object reconstruction into the tracking loop, which can improve long-horizon stability but further increases computational cost.
To reduce optimization overhead, 6DOPE-GS [ 18 ] proposes a 2D Gaussian-Splatting-based representation [ 17 ] for faster online reconstruction and reports a speed–accuracy trade-off.
blocks.zh:
BundleTrack [40]是小说-对象6D平面跟踪的早期框架,不需要CAD模型.
它结合了特性匹配和一个内存增强的外观图,通过未预测出点云的对齐损失来优化(类似于 [6]).
BundleSDF [42]通过将在线对象重建整合到跟踪回路来延长了这一行的工作,这可以提高长相稳定性,但会进一步提高计算成本.
为了减少优化的间接费用,6DOPE-GS [18] 提出2D高斯-镀层代表制[17],以加快在线重建,并报告速度-准确取舍.

blocks.en: Overall, alignment-based objectives in prior object-centric pose-graph trackers [ 40 , 42 , 18 ] can yield accurate pose estimates. However, they couple the dense correspondence inside the global optimization, making optimization cost scale with the number of points or image resolutions. Additionally, this makes them more prone to error on data with noisy depth and degraded correspondence quality. In contrast, we use correspondences only to generate relative pose measurements and then optimize a compact pose graph over relative pose constraints. This design preserves modularity with respect to the correspondence estimator while enabling efficient and robust online updates.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,在以前的以对象为中心的平面图跟踪器中,基于对齐的目标[40、42、18]可以得出准确的预测。 然而,它们将全球优化内部的密集的对应关系相配,使优化的成本规模与点数或图像分辨率相配. 此外,这使他们更容易在数据上出错,其深度噪音和通信质量下降。 相形之下,我们使用函式来产生相对的姿势测量,然后优化一个紧凑的姿势图而不是相对的姿势限制. 这一设计保留了对通信估计器的模块化,同时能够有效而有力地在线更新。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We track the 6D pose of an object across an RGB-D video by maintaining a compact S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) pose graph that is extended and optimized incrementally ( Fig. 2 ) over relative pose constraints. Every new frame contributes an odometry constraint to its predecessor and up to K K loop closure constraints to past keyframes, where each is weighted by an uncertainty derived from the conditioning of the geometric alignment problem.
The formulation is agnostic to how correspondences are obtained and can turn any feature matcher into a 6D object pose tracker.

blocks.en:
Choosing reliable keyframes is crucial to avoid drift that would accumulate when chaining odometries alone without long-range constraints through loop closure edges.
Deciding which past frames to connect to a new frame therefore determines how much of edges are informative.

We update the pose graph using iSAM2 [ 19 ] .
Internally, iSAM2 maintains a sparse factorization of the linearized system using a Bayes-tree representation and performs selective relinearization, so that only variables affected by new constraints are revisited.
This yields low-latency updates suitable for online 6D tracking.
For our online setting, previously estimated poses will also be optimized but only for optimization of future frames.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 评价

blocks.en: In this section, our experiments address four main questions: (1) How does our model compare to state-of-the-art methods in both pose tracking accuracy and runtime efficiency? (2) How sensitive is our method to the quality of correspondences? (3) Does the resulting tracker remain stable over long sequences? (4) How important are the different components of our model?
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们的实验涉及四个主要问题: (1) 在跟踪准确性和运行时间效率方面,我们的模型如何与最新方法进行比较? (2)我们的方法对函文的质量有多敏感? (3) 由此产生的跟踪器是否在长序列上保持稳定? (4) 我们模式的不同组成部分有多重要?

blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: Metrics. We follow the evaluation protocol of [ 42 , 40 , 43 ] and evaluate 6D pose tracking quality using the area under the curve (AUC) percentage for ADD-S and ADD [ 45 ] ( 0 ∼ 0.1 ​ m 0\sim 0.1m ) using ground-truth object models. These metrics measure the mean distance between corresponding points on the predicted and ground-truth object models, providing a robust measure of geometric alignment accuracy. Inference speed is reported in frames per second (fps). Benchmarks. We evaluate our method on four real-world object pose tracking benchmarks, HOI4D [ 26 ] , YCBInEOAT [ 41 ] , HO3D [ 15 ] and YCB Video [ 45 ] . HOI4D [ 26 ] is a large-scale egocentric hand-object interaction dataset, containing 973 videos for 49 rigid objects from 5 categories (toy car, kettle, knife, bowl, chair). The average video length is 300 frames. YCBInEOAT [ 41 ] is an ego-centric robot manipulation dataset that consists of 9 scenes and 5 objects, with 823 frames on average. HO3D [ 15 ] is a hand-object interaction dataset that contains 13 scenes and 4 objects, with average 1547 frames. YCB-Video [ 45 ] contains 21 objects in 12 cluttered scenes with occlusions and symmetric objects. The average length is 1718 frames.

blocks.en:
For our main method, we use RoMa v2 [ 11 ] (turbo) for feature matching. Unless otherwise specified, we use K = 5 K=5 as the default number.
For online graph optimization, we use iSAM2 from the GTSAM [ 7 ] library.
We evaluate causal poses output at the time of arrival w.o. iSAM2 smoothing.
To evaluate against ground-truth pose annotations, we align the predicted trajectory by applying the relative transform between our first-frame prediction and the ground-truth pose of the first frame.
For 6DOPE-GS [ 18 ] , we report their results from the original paper due to its code currently not being available.
All experiments and baselines were conducted on an NVIDIA H100 GPU. We use identical masks for all methods.

Keyframe Selection. Tab. 7 ablates the two components of our keyframe selection stage: the memory pool and farthest-frame sampling (FFS).
Removing the memory pool allows loop closure edges to be drawn from all past frames rather than from a small set of viewpoint-diverse ones, so the selected frames become redundant and carry less information.
Replacing farthest frame sampling with the adjacent K K frames leads to severe pose degeneration since graph connectivity becomes purely local. This confirms that the value of loop closure comes from spanning the sequence rather than from the number of edges.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose a lightweight, correspondence-agnostic framework for online 6D pose tracking of novel objects, built on a compact pose graph optimized with iSAM2.
Rather than fusing dense correspondences into the objective, we use them only to produce relative pose measurements, which the pose graph combines with geometry-derived per-edge uncertainty and viewpoint-diverse frame selection.
Across four benchmarks, our method reaches near-best accuracy among non-CAD methods at a fraction of the optimization cost of reconstruction- and pose-graph-based baselines, while remaining stable over sequences of more than a thousand frames. Our results suggest that accurate object tracking does not require retaining dense correspondences throughout optimization. Instead, compact relative pose measurements, weighted by how well each is constrained, provide comparable accuracy at substantially lower cost.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们提出一个轻量级的可知性框架,用于在线 6D 配置小物体的跟踪,这个框架建立在与 iSAM2 优化的紧凑配置图上.
与其把密集的相通放入目标中去,我们只用它们来产生相对的姿势测量,姿势图结合了几何学衍生出相近的不确定性和观点相向的帧选择.
从四个基准来看,我们的方法在非CAD方法中达到了近乎最佳的准确性,其成本是重建和以平面图为基础的基线的优化成本的一小部分,同时在一千多帧的序列上保持稳定。 我们的结果表明,准确的物体跟踪并不需要在整个优化过程中保留密集的通信。 相反,紧凑的相对数据按各自受限程度加权,以低得多的成本提供可比较的准确性。

blocks.en: 6 Limitation
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en: Our method has two main limitations. First, we assume the object is rigid and we leave tracking articulated and deformable objects as future work. Second, our covariance is a local approximation around the solution RANSAC-Umeyama converges to, so it can capture a flat, poorly-constrained direction but not a well-separated alternative solution (e.g. for textureless symmetric objects). Further work could be a learning-based uncertainty estimator for 6D poses to represent multi-modal pose distributions.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法有两个主要的局限性。 首先,我们假设这个物体是僵硬的,我们留下了跟踪清晰可变的物体作为未来的工作. 其次,我们的同分法是围绕RANSAC-Umeyama相接的溶液的局部近似,这样它就可以捕捉出平坦,约束不严的方向,而不能是分离良好的替代溶液(例如对于无纹理对称对象). 进一步的工作可以是一个基于学习的不确定性估计器,使6D面值能够代表多模式的分布。
